style_authority.note: Resolves the adaptive product context while preserving shared semantic roles and allowing platform-native navigation, controls, icons, materials, and motion.

reference_selection.note: Uses the relevant iOS, Android, adaptive layout, accessibility, theming, navigation, motion, and validation guidance rather than generic mobile advice.

anti_generic_redesign.note: Focuses on native trust, accessible task completion, interruption recovery, and adaptive structure without decorative or pixel-identical restyling.

evidence_level.note: Labels the input L0 static and does not claim source, build, screenshot, accessibility-tree, Simulator, Emulator, performance, or real-device proof.

verified_boundary.note: Separates described implementation facts from unverified contrast, traversal, rotation, multi-window, foldable, performance, gestures, haptics, and recovery behavior.

design_moves.note: Provides eight concrete moves and an intentional parity matrix covering navigation, state recovery, type, targets, semantic tokens, adaptive navigation, controls, and motion.

scope_control.note: Stays read-only and native-UI-focused, fits within 118 lines, and limits the critique to five blockers, eight moves, and a minimal validation plan.
